title: 月光雕刻师 11：还是太慢了
description: 三个星期过去，新的本事出现了。可我一边开心，一边觉得：还是太慢了。

sources.title: The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, volume 1, chapter 2
sources.note: Adapted from the supplied EPUB: three weeks of relentless training, Fighting Spirit and Endurance, Beginner Sword Mastery level 3 at 0% (+30% attack power, +9% attack speed), gains of STR 28 / AGI 25 / VIT 22, and resolve to finish before the four-week restriction ends. Stops before hunger and the instructor’s lunch. The source’s nearly eighty-hour sessions are retained as in-game narration, not a real-world recommendation. New abilities are described as system information, not demonstrated on invented monsters. Choices are brief internal reflections.
